lines.say: The genotype is the combination of alleles an organism has. The letters.
The phenotype is what you see or measure. Height, blood group, enzyme activity.
Phenotype equals genotype plus environment. Like a recipe in a kitchen.
Capital letter for dominant, same letter lower case for recessive.
Homo means same. TT is homozygous dominant, little tt homozygous recessive.
Hetero means different. Big T, little t is heterozygous.
A dominant allele shows whenever it's there, even one copy.

draw.alt: TT and Tt plants both tall; tt plant short

lines.say: A recessive allele shows only when there's no dominant allele.
So a tall plant could be TT or Tt. Only the recessive tells the truth.
Often the dominant allele makes a working protein. The recessive makes a faulty one.
One working allele usually makes enough. Like a lamp with one good bulb.

draw.alt: Lamps: two good bulbs lit, one good bulb lit, no good bulbs dark

lines.say: A heterozygous person with a recessive disease allele, like cystic fibrosis, is a carrier.
Dominant doesn't mean common or better. Huntington's allele is dominant.
Black fur is dominant to white. A white and a black guinea pig breed.
The white parent shows the recessive phenotype, so it's little b, little b.
Some offspring are white, so they got a little b from the black parent.
So the black parent must be heterozygous.
Hydrangea cuttings are clones. Same genotype in every plant.
Acidic soil gives blue flowers. More alkaline soil gives pink.

draw.alt: Same hydrangea cutting gives blue flowers in acidic soil and pink in alkaline soil

lines.say: Siamese cats grow dark fur only on cool spots: ears, nose, paws and tail.
PKU: a low-phenylalanine diet protects the phenotype. The genotype doesn't change.
One gene gives separate categories. Many genes plus environment give a smooth range.
Epigenetics changes gene expression without changing the DNA sequence.
DNA methylation adds methyl groups near a gene. It's usually silenced.
Histone modification changes how tightly DNA is wound. Tight means switched off.

draw.alt: Loosely wound DNA around histones becomes tightly packed and silenced

lines.say: Diet, stress and smoking can change these marks. That's why identical twins drift apart.
Use the same letter for both alleles of a gene.
lines.write: T and t, not T and s

lines.say: The environment changes phenotype, not genotype.
Explain dominance with proteins: one working allele is enough.
For epigenetics, name a mechanism and say the sequence is unchanged.
